pr_body:
This should make two -Werror=maybe-initialized issues go away. I didn#t
test this, since I don't have immediate access to relevant platforms
(see #19695), but I am quite confident that this should make the issue
go away.

Note that this is not a bugfix, since there is no bug afaics. It's just
that gcc  is a bit too simple here.

Fixes #19695

issue_context.title: -Werror=maybe-initialized false positives with -O2 on ppc64el and s390x on ubuntu 21.04
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
 > upstream daily build https://code.launchpad.net/~ubuntu-support-team/+recipe/systemd


**Used distribution**
 > Ubuntu 21.04 (hirsute) and unreleased 21.10 (impish)

**CPU architecture issue was seen on**
 > ppc64el (powerpc64 little-endian) and s390x

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
 > no maybe-uninitialized false positive error from gcc

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
 > build failure due to false-positive -Werror=maybe-uninitialized

**Steps to reproduce the problem**
 > build using latest upstream systemd code on Ubuntu 21.04 (or 21.10) release

A log from a failed build on ppc64el is here:
https://launchpadlibrarian.net/539840496/buildlog_ubuntu-hirsute-ppc64el.systemd_248.1100.g674d8dcc47+21.04.20210521173555_BUILDING.txt.gz

with the specific error (or first error, at least) being:

> FAILED: src/shared/libsystemd-shared-248.a.p/efi-loader.c.o 
> cc -Isrc/shared/libsystemd-shared-248.a.p -Isrc/shared -I../src/shared -Isrc/basic -I../src/basic -Isrc/fundamental -I../src/fundamental -Isrc/systemd -I../src/systemd -I. -I.. -I../src/libsystemd/sd-bus -I../src/libsystemd/sd-device -I../src/libsystemd/sd-event -I../src/libsystemd/sd-hwdb -I../src/libsystemd/sd-id128 -I../src/libsystemd/sd-journal -I../src/libsystemd/sd-netlink -I../src/libsystemd/sd-network -I../src/libsystemd/sd-resolve -I/usr/include/blkid -I/usr/include/libmount -flto=auto -fdiagnostics-color=always -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 -Wall -Winvalid-pch -Wextra -Werror -std=gnu99 -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-missing-field-initializers -Wno-unused-result -Wno-format-signedness -Werror=undef -Wlogical-op -Wmissing-include-dirs -Wold-style-definition -Wpointer-arith -Winit-self -Wfloat-equal -Wsuggest-attribute=noreturn -Werror=missing-prototypes -Werror=implicit-function-declaration -Werror=missing-declarations -Werror=return-type -Werror=incompatible-pointer-types -Werror=format=2 -Wstrict-prototypes -Wredundant-decls -Wmissing-noreturn -Wimplicit-fallthrough=5 -Wshadow -Wendif-labels -Wstrict-aliasing=2 -Wwrite-strings -Werror=overflow -Werror=shift-count-overflow -Werror=shift-overflow=2 -Wdate-time -Wnested-externs -ffast-math -fno-common -fdiagnostics-show-option -fno-strict-aliasing -fvisibility=hidden -fstack-protector -fstack-protector-strong --param=ssp-buffer-size=4 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Werror=shadow -include config.h -g -O3 -ffile-prefix-map=/<<BUILDDIR>>/systemd-248.1100.g674d8dcc47+21.04.20210521173555=. -flto=auto -ffat-lto-objects -fstack-protector-strong -Wformat -Werror=format-security -Wdate-time -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fPIC -pthread -fvisibility=default -MD -MQ src/shared/libsystemd-shared-248.a.p/efi-loader.c.o -MF src/shared/libsystemd-shared-248.a.p/efi-loader.c.o.d -o src/shared/libsystemd-shared-248.a.p/efi-loader.c.o -c ../src/shared/efi-loader.c
> ../src/shared/efi-loader.c: In function ‘efi_get_reboot_to_firmware’:

>       |                ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
> In file included from ../src/basic/alloc-util.h:9,
>                  from ../src/shared/efi-loader.c:7:
> ../src/shared/efi-loader.c: In function ‘efi_set_reboot_to_firmware’:
> ../src/basic/macro.h:359:34: error: ‘b’ may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]

A log from failed s390x build is here:
https://launchpadlibrarian.net/539840754/buildlog_ubuntu-hirsute-s390x.systemd_248.1100.g674d8dcc47+21.04.20210521173555_BUILDING.txt.gz

and the specific (or first) failure is:

> FAILED: src/basic/libbasic.a.p/rm-rf.c.o 
> cc -Isrc/basic/libbasic.a.p -Isrc/basic -I../src/basic -Isrc/fundamental -I../src/fundamental -Isrc/systemd -I../src/systemd -I. -I.. -flto=auto -fdiagnostics-color=always -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 -Wall -Winvalid-pch -Wextra -Werror -std=gnu99 -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-missing-field-initializers -Wno-unused-result -Wno-format-signedness -Werror=undef -Wlogical-op -Wmissing-include-dirs -Wold-style-definition -Wpointer-arith -Winit-self -Wfloat-equal -Wsuggest-attribute=noreturn -Werror=missing-prototypes -Werror=implicit-function-declaration -Werror=missing-declarations -Werror=return-type -Werror=incompatible-pointer-types -Werror=format=2 -Wstrict-prototypes -Wredundant-decls -Wmissing-noreturn -Wimplicit-fallthrough=5 -Wshadow -Wendif-labels -Wstrict-aliasing=2 -Wwrite-strings -Werror=overflow -Werror=shift-count-overflow -Werror=shift-overflow=2 -Wdate-time -Wnested-externs -ffast-math -fno-common -fdiagnostics-show-option -fno-strict-aliasing -fvisibility=hidden -fstack-protector -fstack-protector-strong --param=ssp-buffer-size=4 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Werror=shadow -include config.h -g -O2 -ffile-prefix-map=/<<BUILDDIR>>/systemd-248.1100.g674d8dcc47+21.04.20210521173555=. -flto=auto -ffat-lto-objects -fstack-protector-strong -Wformat -Werror=format-security -Wdate-time -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fPIC -pthread -fvisibility=default -MD -MQ src/basic/libbasic.a.p/rm-rf.c.o -MF src/basic/libbasic.a.p/rm-rf.c.o.d -o src/basic/libbasic.a.p/rm-rf.c.o -c ../src/basic/rm-rf.c
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c: In function ‘rm_rf_children’:
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c:108:24: error: ‘old_mode’ may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
>   108 |                 (void) fchmod(dfd, old_mode);
>       |                        ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c:92:16: note: ‘old_mode’ was declared here
>    92 |         mode_t old_mode;
>       |                ^~~~~~~~
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c:76:24: error: ‘old_mode’ may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
>    76 |                 (void) fchmod(dfd, old_mode);
>       |                        ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c:57:16: note: ‘old_mode’ was declared here
>    57 |         mode_t old_mode;
>       |                ^~~~~~~~
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c:76:24: error: ‘old_mode’ may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
>    76 |                 (void) fchmod(dfd, old_mode);
>       |                        ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
> ../src/basic/rm-rf.c:57:16: note: ‘old_mode’ was declared here
>    57 |         mode_t old_mode;
>       |                ^~~~~~~~
> cc1: all warnings being treated as errors
> 

These both look like false positives from gcc, and it seems like this has been a problem in the past, and it was just re-enabled with https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/19226

Possibly there are fixes to gcc that the ubuntu release is missing?

This doesn't affect anything currently, as even if we move Ubuntu CI up to focal, these errors don't show up there (in focal), so this may just be of interest because it's annoying to me (due to the build failures in my daily builder) and also @mbiebl and @rbalint might be affected in the future, as commit 68c98a411d6 hasn't made it into debian or ubuntu yet
comments: per discussion in #20011, closing this, as it's a problem in gcc that appears fixed in the latest gcc-11.
